jobs.description: Role  You’ll improve and extend the decision logic behind our battery fleet. Our optimization already runs our batteries every day; now we want to make it sharper, more robust and ready for new use cases. Our batteries sit behind the meter at industrial sites, so every decision has to balance customer savings, grid constraints and market value under uncertainty. Our data scientists and quantitative researchers work as one team and often across each other's topics.     What you will do  The role covers two closely linked areas. You can work in either one and switch between them as priorities and your interests evolve:     Fleet optimization:  Plan how each battery runs over the coming hours and days, combining customer savings, grid fee rules and market value within each site's limits. Forecasts of load, PV and prices are generated and fed into the plan, which has to stay robust to their uncertainty. You also measure how much value we actually capture.     On-site control:  Make the plan work in reality.
